## ILmdbEnvOptions.remapChunks property

Use dynamic memory mapping (frees mapped memory for other apps).

**Signature:**

```typescript
remapChunks?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Slightly slower reads, friendlier to other applications. Enabled by default on 32-bit systems.
